What this means for your project

Everything on this page was designed, built and published by us. That is why we know what an app, game or AI solution really costs and where the pitfalls are. You benefit from that experience.

  • App: a basic app from €3,150 and a standard app from €6,750. Fixed price, one build for iPhone and Android. See app development.
  • Game: a branded casual game from €1,950, playable on your phone before you approve it.
  • AI and automation: from €395, including a chatbot trained on your own content from €995. See AI chatbot.
  • Website: from €495. See website design.

You always start with a free concept within 48 hours, so you can see what you get before you decide. All prices are in euros and are final.
